title: Privacy Policy
intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what information we collect when you use our website or make an enquiry, and how we use it.

blocks.text: When you send an enquiry we collect the details you provide — your name, email address, phone number, preferred destination, travel dates, number of travellers and any message you include.

items: To respond to your enquiry and prepare quotations
To arrange and manage bookings you make with us
To send occasional travel offers, only if you have agreed to receive them
To improve our website and services

blocks.text: We share your details only with the hotels, transport providers and partners needed to deliver your holiday, and with service providers who help us run our business (such as our email platform). We never sell your personal information.
You can ask us to access, correct or delete your personal information, or unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time, by contacting us using the details on our Contact page.

seo.title: Privacy Policy
